# newclear

> `fallrising`'s public technical portfolio: 32 components that were previously scattered across separate repositories, now canonical here. Products, gateways and systems software, platform services, desktop applications, tools, specifications and labs.

This file is the single-fetch index. Each entry links to the component's own `llms.txt` where one exists, otherwise to its README, and carries the documentation tier from the root [README.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/README.md) catalog. A component's own capability file is the one to trust about it: it declares tier, status, interface kinds, entrypoint, auth and where the machine-readable contract lives. See [docs/specs/llms-txt.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/docs/specs/llms-txt.md) for the format.

Tiers are the owner's investment and documentation decision, defined in [docs/portfolio-doc-tiers.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/docs/portfolio-doc-tiers.md): **A** active, **B** maintained public contract, **C** dormant, **D** retired, and **ungraded** where the owner has not assigned one yet. Most of this portfolio is C or D. A dormant component may still run perfectly — tier says nobody is maintaining it, not that it is broken — and a tier-A component may be a specification with no code yet. Read both the tier and the status before calling anything.

Capability files exist so far for four components — `systems/clarkq`, `products/kith`, `systems/snail` and `products/goku` — chosen because they fail differently. Adoption is deliberately incomplete; the remaining entries link to a README that may or may not describe the interface.

Boundaries between components are recorded in [PORTFOLIO.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/PORTFOLIO.md), including which components deliberately do not absorb each other's scope. Private work lives in a separate repository, `kernel`, and is not indexed here.

## Products

- [products/kith](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/kith/llms.txt): **A** — group chat where humans and LLM agents are first-class members of one room; MCP, HTTP and WebSocket on Cloudflare Workers. Specification complete, not deployed. Has a capability file.
- [products/hai-taskboard](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/hai-taskboard/README.md): **A** — Human–AI delivery control plane (Work Graph / Fake-core). Go, React. A future consumer of the owner's private project-ledger format, not a replacement for it.
- [products/goku](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/goku/llms.txt): **C** — bookmark ingestion and management; HTTP API over SQLite, CLI, MQTT consumer, React UI. Released and working, no auth, future undecided. Has a capability file.
- [products/phark](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/phark/README.md): **C** — social stream deck: accounts, interactions, search, media, moderation. Spring, React, SQLite.

## Gateways and systems software

- [systems/mkfk](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/systems/mkfk/README.md): **B** — Kafka-inspired distributed log: partition WAL, Raft, ISR, idempotent producer, consumer groups. Specification and contracts, not implemented. Schemas in [api/schemas/](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/systems/mkfk/api/schemas/).
- [systems/clarkq](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/systems/clarkq/llms.txt): **C** — HTTP FIFO message queue in Go with durability, auth, encryption, metrics and three client SDKs. Released v1.5.1, dormant, no new cluster features. Has a capability file.
- [systems/snail](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/systems/snail/llms.txt): **C** — RESP2-compatible in-memory data server in Rust, focused on connection scale. Command subset works, upper limits unproven, kept for its benchmark history. Has a capability file.
- [systems/ojbquay](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/systems/ojbquay/README.md): **C** — Kafka-based enterprise messaging control and data plane. Java, gRPC. The interface contract is [proto/ojbk/v1/](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/systems/ojbquay/proto/ojbk/v1/). Apache-2.0.
- [systems/wotar](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/systems/wotar/README.md): **C** — MQTT application-layer end-to-end encryption client and protocol. Python. Protocol in [secure-mqtt-e2ee/docs/protocol.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/systems/wotar/secure-mqtt-e2ee/docs/protocol.md).
- [gateways/pokercase](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/gateways/pokercase/README.md): **C** — multi-provider LLM gateway (thinrouter): routing, subscription import, UI and TUI. Rust, SQLite. Client setup in [docs/CLIENTS.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/gateways/pokercase/docs/CLIENTS.md).

## Platform

- [platform/agent-platform](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/agent-platform/README.md): **A** — self-hosted multi-agent web workbench modelled on OpenHands Agent Canvas, with Cocoon sandboxing. Not a deployment claim; deliberately separate from `fanzloud` and `kith`.
- [platform/dim-gate](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/dim-gate/README.md): **A** — CMDB-centred enterprise operations self-service front end, as a demo. Specification baseline, not implemented; [docs/openapi.json](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/dim-gate/docs/openapi.json) is generated from Zod and verified in CI.
- [platform/edge-ops](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/edge-ops/README.md): **A** — Cloudflare and host-agent monitoring with controlled operations. SDD plus an M0 contract layer; no runtime, no live deployment, monitor-only by default.
- [platform/signal-hub](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/signal-hub/README.md): **A** — personal event hub: CloudEvents store, rule-generated metrics, subscription delivery. SDD only. It carries events, not decisions or actions.
- [platform/ice-maker](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/ice-maker/README.md): **A** — local-first personal engineering knowledge compiler: document ingestion and reproducible publishing. Python, CLI and FastAPI.
- [platform/local-ocr-services](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/local-ocr-services/README.md): **B** — self-hostable CPU-first OCR HTTP services. Python, Docker. Endpoints, headers and response shape in [docs/api.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/local-ocr-services/docs/api.md).
- [platform/fanzloud](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/fanzloud/README.md): **C** — cloud coding-agent platform and BYOS control layer. Rust. HTTP surface specified in [docs/specs/SPEC-T005B-p0-http-api.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/fanzloud/docs/specs/SPEC-T005B-p0-http-api.md).
- [platform/prism](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/prism/README.md): **C** — storage-pluggable observability compatibility layer in Go, with an SPI and a console API. References: [19-CONSOLE-API-REFERENCE.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/prism/docs/sdd/19-CONSOLE-API-REFERENCE.md), [14-SPI-GO-REFERENCE.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/prism/docs/sdd/14-SPI-GO-REFERENCE.md), [02-COMPATIBILITY-CONTRACT.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/prism/docs/sdd/02-COMPATIBILITY-CONTRACT.md).

## Applications and tools

- [tools/cc-quota](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/tools/cc-quota/README.md): **A** — Claude Code quota pacing monitor: hourly collection into SQLite, read-only reporting, notification only on deviation. Collection and presentation are decoupled; it never refreshes or stores credentials.
- [tools/codex-usage](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/tools/codex-usage/README.md): **A** — read-only Codex subscription usage collector: one App Server snapshot, no model turn, fail-closed JSON. Not production-ready before live acceptance.
- [apps/loom](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/apps/loom/README.md): **C** — AI-native canvas, terminal and document workspace. Tauri, Rust, React. Desktop; no documented external interface.
- [apps/flowshot](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/apps/flowshot/README.md): **C** — local-first, strictly read-only Markdown annotation desktop app. Contracts in [contracts/](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/apps/flowshot/contracts/).
- [apps/cms-scaffold](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/apps/cms-scaffold/README.md): **C** — reusable CMS kernel: Java API with front, back and admin surfaces. The contract source is a handwritten [openapi.yaml](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/apps/cms-scaffold/services/cms-api/src/main/resources/openapi/openapi.yaml).
- [apps/cloudform](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/apps/cloudform/README.md): **D** — Terraform-schema-driven cloud provisioning with a WYSIWYG form designer. Retired. API design in [docs/04-api-design.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/apps/cloudform/docs/04-api-design.md).
- [tools/streaming-converter](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/tools/streaming-converter/README.md): **D** — FFmpeg HLS conversion, cleanup, Nginx serving and a web player. Bash. Retired.

## Specifications, labs and examples

- [specs/fleet](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/specs/fleet/README.md): **B** — executable Fleet Catalog: `fleet.yaml`, Compose, outbound agents, Cloudflare. A component with code and tests despite living under `specs/`; see [docs/taxonomy.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/docs/taxonomy.md). JSON Schemas in [schemas/](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/specs/fleet/schemas/). Apache-2.0.
- [labs/eru-vps-mvp](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/labs/eru-vps-mvp/README.md): **A** — four-machine VPS MVP experiment for Project Eru. Real host changes require separate authorisation.
- [labs/mithril-research](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/labs/mithril-research/README.md): **A** — source and documentation research on `projecteru2/mithril` with a verification design. Research only: no upstream code is imported, and it does not revive `systems/snail`.
- [labs/browser-fingerprint](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/labs/browser-fingerprint/README.md): **ungraded** — bounded lab comparing the observable signals of different browsers and computer-use agents: Go mock CRUD API, a five-step guided task, local JSONL device and action logs, optional Quick Tunnel. A fingerprint proves neither personal identity nor human-versus-AI. Long-term investment not yet decided.
- [examples/bite-pi](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/examples/bite-pi/README.md): **D** — public Pi agent demonstration consuming a published platform contract. A consumer, not a service.
- [labs/bee-swarm](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/labs/bee-swarm/README.md): **D** — AI role collaboration and workflow simulation, historical. Flask; [docs/09-appendix/api-reference.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/labs/bee-swarm/docs/09-appendix/api-reference.md).
- [labs/aweshore](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/labs/aweshore/README.md): **D** — early personal notes/PKM attempt, discontinued. Go HTTP service, minimal documentation.

## Optional

- [README.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/README.md): the human-facing catalog in Traditional Chinese, with the technology stack and tier per component, and the commit-trailer rule for contributors.
- [PORTFOLIO.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/PORTFOLIO.md): the public summary of invest/dormant/retire decisions and the standing boundaries between components. Authority lives in the owner's private project ledger.
- [docs/taxonomy.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/docs/taxonomy.md): the rules for what belongs in each top-level directory, including why `specs/` is not documentation-only.
- [docs/portfolio-doc-tiers.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/docs/portfolio-doc-tiers.md): the A/B/C/D documentation depth policy and its README templates.
- [docs/specs/monorepo-ci.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/docs/specs/monorepo-ci.md): which components have root-level CI and what those workflows do and do not cover.
- [MIGRATION.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/MIGRATION.md): how these components were consolidated from separate repositories into this monorepo.
- [refs/INDEX.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/refs/INDEX.md): 67 repositories written by other people, kept as an index of notes and tags rather than forks. Nothing there is this author's work.
- [LICENSE](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT at the root. `systems/ojbquay` and `specs/fleet` are Apache-2.0 per their own `LICENSE`.
